EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 596 May 22, 1980
AMENDING EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 183 REGARDING THE CREATION OF THE NATIONAL
FOOD AND AGRICULTURE COUNCIL
WHEREAS, there is a need for a coordinating agency that shall oversee, unify and integrate the
administration and implementation of the government's food self-sufficiency program;
WHEREAS, the farmer, being the main cog in the task of food production, should be represented in the
council that coordinate our national food program;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Republic of the Philippines, by virtue
of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby amend the composition of the National Food and Agriculture
Council as follows:
1. Ministry of Agriculture
Minister Arturo R. Tanco, Jr.
Chairman-Coordinator
2. National Grains Authority
Jesus T. Tanchanco
Administrator
3. Bureau of Plan Industry
Domingo F. Panganiban
4. Bureau of Agricultural Extension
Francisco G. Rentutar
5. Bureau of Soils
Godofredo N. Alcasid
6. University of the Philippines at Los Baños
Dr. Emil Q. Javier
Chancellor
7. Bureau of Animal Industry
Dr. Salvador H. Escudero, III
8. Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources
Felix R. Gonzales
9. Ministry of the Budget
Jaime C. Laya
10. Ministry of Agrarian Reform
Conrado F. Estrella
11. Agricultural Credit Administration
Teofilo T. Azada
Administrator
12. Ministry of Local Government and Community Development
13. Central Bank Dept. of Rural Banks and Savings and Loans Association
Consolacion V. Odra
14. Philippine National Bank
Panfilo O. Domingo
15. Development Bank of the Philippines
Rafael A. Sison
16. National Irrigation Administration
Dr. Fiorelio R. Estuar
Administrator
17. Bureau of Agricultural Economics
Jesus C. Alix
18. National Economic Development Authority
Dr. Gerardo P. Sicat
Director-General
19. Agrarian Reform Beneficiaries Association
Maning B. Rotea, Sr.
20. Federation of Agrarian and Industrial Toiling Hands, Inc./HUKBALAHAP Veterans Association
Luis M. Taruc
21. Federation of Farmers Association of the Philippines
Ben V. Bautista, Sr.
22. Federation of Free Farmers
Jerry U. Montemayor
23. Federation of Land Reform Farmers
Ben Andraneda
24. Katipunan ng mga Magsasaka sa Pilipinas
Nellie V. Chavez
25. Pambansang Katipunan ng mga Samahang Nayon sa Pilipinas
Ambong Lumibao
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of May, in the Year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Eighty.
